_comment: Ensemble spec for `evaluate_full.py --ensemble_config`. Member softmaxes are averaged.
`defaults` applies to every member; each member may override any of the same keys, so
checkpoints trained with DIFFERENT architecture flags can be combined -- which matters
here, because the record run (20260818_003229, E8) is the only one with directional
gating and the others are not. Architecture flags MUST match how each checkpoint was
trained or it will refuse to load.
`weight` is optional (default 1.0) and is normalized across members.

models._note: E8 -- the 64.79 record run. Only member with directional gating.
E5 -- 64.23, isotropic. Architecturally the most different from E8.
E10 -- 62.92, vertical stencil reach 4. Weaker alone; kept for diversity.
